spec_basis.quote: a selected clip nudges left or right by one frame or by the configured multi-frame step, and up or down by one track. Slip and slide have their own one-and-many nudge pairs. The multi-frame step is a single preference shared by every "many" variant so that one setting governs the whole surface.

found_beside_the_table: ClipNudge had no spec_command although the tables name its four ids. Fixed.
The doc above key_command called Alt+Left and Alt+Right a harness binding, Premiere's UNVERIFIED; the tables name them. Fixed, comment only.
A clip nudge right into a neighbour overwrites it: clip 2 by one left clip 3 at (51, 70, 11, 30). Pinned, not changed.
A linked clip refuses left and right, linked_move_unsupported, though the clause says a selected clip nudges. Pinned, not changed.
Left past zero refuses outside_range, where slip and slide commit the achieved delta. Pinned, not changed.

declared_readings: Up and down are the rows the Viewer draws (harness-view track_order): up is the next higher index on caption and video, the next lower on audio and submix. Test up_lands_on_the_row_above_in_the_drawn_order checks the planner against track_order. Vendor UNVERIFIED (D5).

An occupied range refuses and nothing is overwritten, trimmed or shifted, whatever the sync locks say; touching is free. Follows merge-sync's refusal of a collision. This differs from left and right, which overwrite through plan_move. Vendor UNVERIFIED (D5).

Link partners follow merge-sync's LinkedSelection. On: the whole group takes the one index step its first named clip asks for, in each member's own stack, so V1 + A1 go to V2 + A2 and the audio row goes down when the video row goes up. A partner that cannot go refuses the whole edit, naming the partner. Suspended: the named clip moves alone and keeps its group id. Vendor UNVERIFIED (D5).

Two members of a group on one track refuse linked_edit_unsupported, as merge-sync states for every linked edit. With On that also refuses a group already holding two members on one track if they land together.
A selection moves as one step, and a range another selected clip leaves counts as free.
A transition stays where it still plays, and otherwise is removed and listed in dropped_transitions. Both clips of a transition nudged together keep it.

The brief asks for the exhaustive carry the footprint lane added. That carry is harness-view's carry_across_move, needed because plan_move rebuilds the clip. The planner moves the StudioClip value whole, so no field is copied and none needs a carry; the exhaustive destructure that matters is pulse's diff. Proven by whole-clip equality, tests a_track_nudge_changes_only_the_track_of_a_clip and a_track_nudge_keeps_every_member_of_the_clip.
The Viewer passes LinkedSelection::On: it has no linked-selection toggle state.
